items.source: Return a predicate that considers whether the target type is participating in the type hierarchy.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，用于判断目标类型是否参与类型层次结构。

items.source: Return a predicate that represents the logical negation of this predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个表示该谓词逻辑否定的谓词。

items.source: Evaluates this predicate on the given arguments.
items.translation: 在给定参数上评估此谓词。

items.source: Any exceptions thrown during evaluation of either predicate are relayed to the caller; if evaluation of this predicate throws an exception, the other predicate will not be evaluated.
items.translation: 在评估任一谓词期间抛出的任何异常都会传递给调用者；如果此谓词的评估抛出异常，则不会评估other谓词。

items.source: Represents a predicate (boolean-valued function) of a target type and its underlying type.
items.translation: 表示一个目标类型及其底层类型的谓词（布尔值函数）。

items.source: Return a composed predicate that represents a short-circuiting logical AND of this predicate and another.
items.translation: 返回一个组合谓词，表示此谓词与另一个谓词的短路逻辑与。

items.source: other - a predicate that will be logically-ANDed with this predicate
items.translation: other - 一个将与当前谓词进行逻辑与运算的谓词

items.source: a composed predicate that represents the short-circuiting logical AND of this predicate and the other predicate
items.translation: 一个组合谓词，表示此谓词与other谓词的短路逻辑与。

items.source: Gerrit Meier, Mark Paluch, Christoph Strobl, Oliver Drotbohm
true if the input argument matches the predicate, otherwise false.
items.translation: 如果输入参数匹配谓词，则返回 true；否则返回 false。

items.source: a predicate that represents the logical negation of this predicate
items.translation: 表示该谓词逻辑否定的谓词

items.source: Return a composed predicate that represents a short-circuiting logical AND of this predicate and another. When evaluating the composed predicate, if this predicate is false, then the other predicate is not evaluated.
items.translation: 返回一个组合谓词，表示此谓词与另一个谓词的短路逻辑与。在评估组合谓词时，如果此谓词为假，则不评估other谓词。
